0.original: Moegramm has been losing sleep over his sheep.

1.original: The wool from Moegramm's sheep lacks its former luster, and won't fetch a fair price at market. The shepherd Chartain should know how to make the sheep shine again.

2.original: Chartain attributes the lackluster fleece to lice, and attributes the lice to a lack of farmhands to help with brushing. Delouse three shaggy sheep with the lice comb.

3.original: Inform Moegramm that his shaggy sheep now have a sheepy sheen.

4.original: Moegramm is grateful you brushed up his wool for market. It would have been a shame to make mutton of the sheep when he seems so...attached.

25.original: Use the lice comb on the shaggy sheep.

48.original: They call me the Stead shepherd, but all three kinds of livestock we breed here fall under my crook. Nevertheless, sheep remain my first love, my one true passion.

49.original: So you can imagine my dismay at finding my flock in frumpy fleece! I can't very well take worn-out wool to market. A sheep with no shine is good for nothing but mutton!

50.original: But where there's wool, there's a way! See what Chartain has to say.

51.original: Moegramm had some little lambs whose fleece was white as snow. But everywhere the little lambs went, lice were sure to go. Now we're stuck with lousy sheep.

52.original: In the time it takes me to brush one clean, the lice spread to two more. I just can't keep up with them by myself!

53.original: If you could brush three shaggy sheep for me, we might be able to wipe out the infestation altogether.

54.original: Let Moegramm know his sheep are in shipshape once you've finished.

58.original: For an adventurer, you certainly know how to wield a lice comb!

59.original: As I'm sure you have found, sheep are delicate souls that require delicate care. Truly wonderful wool requires time, love, and tenderness.

60.original: You must caress their coats ever so gently, listen to their soft bleating in your ear, feel the warmth of their breath on your neck...
